text.tspan: Each number is the least number of queen moves an amazon of that side needs to reach the square (multi-source BFS from all its amazons; '-' = unreachable).
Blue: White is closer (32 squares). Red: Black is closer (24 squares). Grey: same distance (no owner).
evaluate(state, WHITE) = W1 * territory + W2 * mobility = 1.0 * 8 + 0.2 * 10 = 10
